data.title: World Cup final scorer Torres leads Ballon d'Or nominees
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Ferran Torres, whose goal against Argentina won the World Cup for Spain in July, leads a 30-man list for the men's Ballon d'Or revealed on Tuesday.

data.title: Trump and Putin hold ‘constructive’ phone call
data.description: MOSCOW — Russian President ​Vladimir Putin and ​US President Donald ‌Trump had a “constructive and frank” hour-long telephone call during which ​Trump ⁠stressed his wish for the ‌war in Ukraine to end as soon as ⁠possible, a Kremlin aide said on Tuesday.

data.title: Spain releasing intelligence reports into Ceuta migrant rush
data.description: MADRID - The Spanish government on Tuesday declassified intelligence reports about July’s migrant surge into its north African enclave Ceuta in a bid to quell doubts about what it knew beforehand and the potential role of Morocco.

data.title: UK, France and Canada sanction Israeli settlers
data.description: LONDON - Britain on Tuesday announced a trade ban on goods made in Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank in coordination with France and Canada, the latest sanctions to target Israel as it faces growing diplomatic isolation.

data.title: French far right silent on AfD triumph in Germany
data.description: PARIS - The French far right has kept a guarded silence over the far-right Alternative for Germany’s (AfD) triumph in regional elections, wary that too close an association with the party could harm Marine Le Pen’s chances in France’s 2027 presidential vote.

data.title: Lebanon town buries its dead after Israeli strike
data.description: KFAR RUMMAN, Lebanon - Hundreds of people in south Lebanon gathered on Tuesday to mourn two Hezbollah members and their family, among them a three-month-old infant, killed by an Israeli strike a day prior.

data.title: Nicaragua accuses Germany of complicity in Gaza genocide
data.description: THE HAGUE - Nicaragua accused Germany of "multiple violations of international law" at the United Nations top court on Tuesday, as it pressed its case that Berlin is complicit in what it described as genocide in Gaza.

data.title: Thai clinic linked to penile-filler fatality investigated
data.description: Thai public health officials have opened an investigation into the death of a British influencer who died after receiving a penile filler injection at a clinic in Pathumwan district of Bangkok in March.

data.title: Thaivivat Unveils AI Crash-Detection System as Profits Surge 102%
data.description: Thaivivat Insurance marks 75 years with an AI crash-detection launch, as parent Thaivivat Holdings posts 102% profit growth and eyes double-digit growth

data.title: Nicaragua accuses Germany of multiple violations of law in Gaza genocide case
data.description: THE HAGUE - Nicaragua accused Germany of "multiple violations of international law" at the United Nations top court on Tuesday, as it pressed its case that Berlin is complicit in what it described as genocide in Gaza.

data.title: On London's Brick Lane, a data centre sparks local battle
data.description: LONDON - In Brick Lane, the historic heart of London’s Bangladeshi community, residents oppose plans for a data centre in a disused brewery, citing the erosion of heritage and need for social housing.

data.title: Nepal flood death toll rises as rescuers scour tunnels
data.description: KATHMANDU - The death toll from Nepal's devastating flood rose on Tuesday to 1,357, with 5,326 people still missing, the country's disaster authority said nearly two weeks after the August 26 disaster.

data.title: Thieves steal Renoir paintings from France museum
data.description: CAGNES-SUR-MER - Thieves on Tuesday stole four Renoir paintings worth millions of US dollars from a museum in southern France, but abandoned two as they fled, a mayor said.

data.title: Royal Cliff Hotels Wins Chinese Travellers' Hearts with Trip.com Certification
data.description: Pattaya, Thailand – Royal Cliff Hotels Group is proud to announce that all four of its award-winning hotels, Royal Cliff Beach Hotel, Royal Cliff Beach Terrace, Royal Cliff Grand Hotel and Royal Wing Suites & Spa, have beenrecognisedwith the Chinese Friendly HotelCertificate by Trip.com. This prestigious recognition reflects Royal Cliff's ongoing commitment to delivering exceptional experiences andcapturingtravellers’hearts.

data.title: Nepal glacier saw exceptional heat before collapse caused deadly floods: researcher
data.description: PARIS - The mountain section whose collapse triggered fatal floods in Nepal and China on Aug 26 had experienced unprecedented heat for the time of year, meteorological data analysed by a researcher shows.

data.title: Court orders elimination of invasive blackchin tilapia
data.description: The Central Administrative Court on Tuesday ordered the Department of Fisheries and its director-general to proceed with efforts to eliminate invasive blackchin tilapia from Thai waterways and the Interior Ministry to declare Samut Songkhram a disaster area.

data.title: Thailand’s oldest hippo turns 61
data.description: A lively and heartwarming 61st birthday ceremony was held on Tuesday for Mae Mali, Thailand’s oldest hippopotamus, at Khao Kheow Open Zoo in Chon Buri, with animal lovers and fans gathering to offer best wishes as she enjoyed a special fruit cake.

data.title: Ethiopia boosts drone production to fight rebels
data.description: ADDIS ABABA — Ethiopia has been manufacturing drones at two factories since last year and is now thought to have a fleet of thousands, analysts say, giving the government an edge against its multiple insurgent enemies.

data.title: Phuket group seeks to stop Jewish New Year event
data.description: PHUKET - A group of Phuket residents on Tuesday demanded a ban on a planned Jewish New Year celebration on the island, saying it would draw conflict to the island amid the continued Middle East war.

data.title: Scammers caught with victim lists and swindle scripts
data.description: Police have arrested 13 scam suspects and seized victim contact lists and swindle scripts at a house in Bang Phli district in Samut Prakan, and also caught a fugitive Korean fraudster hiding in Prachuap Khiri Khan.

data.title: Nepalis mark a year since deadly protests that toppled government
data.description: KATHMANDU - Dozens of young people congregated at Nepal’s burnt-out parliament building on Tuesday to mark the anniversary of deadly anti-corruption protests that toppled the former government.

data.title: Yemen rebel strikes on Saudi Arabia wound 73
data.description: RIYADH - Yemen's Houthi rebels struck a series of targets in Saudi Arabia on Tuesday, wounding 73, in their heaviest attack since the conflict reignited during the Middle East war.

data.title: North Korea hails Russia bridge as sign of tighter ties
data.description: SEOUL - North Korea called the first road bridge across its narrow border with Russia a concrete sign of tightening bonds, state media reported Tuesday, as Pyongyang gains advantages from its powerful neighbours Moscow and Beijing.

data.title: CKPower Advances into Second Half of 2026 with Additional 5 MW of Solar Capacity
data.description: Thanawat Trivisvavet, Managing Director of CK Power Public Company Limited or CKPower (SET: CKP), one of the region’s largest producers of electricity from renewables with one of the lowest carbon footprints, outlined thecompany’s operating outlook for the second half of2026.Thecompany commenced commercial operations of an additional5MW of solar power projects developed in collaboration with Bangkok Expressway and Metro Public Company Limited (BEM) inSeptember.The additional capacity expands CKPower’s renewable energy portfolio, while supporting the use of renewable energy in Thailand’s transportation and infrastructure sectors and the continued expansion of thecompany’s renewable energy business.

data.title: Singapore proposes big salary hike for ministers
data.description: SINGAPORE - ⁠The Singapore government has accepted an independent committee’s recommendations for a sharp increase in ministerial ​salaries, which are already the highest ‌in the world, Prime ⁠Minister Lawrence Wong said on ​Tuesday.

data.title: Rubio launches Latin America tour to cement US influence
data.description: BARRANQUILLA (COLOMBIA) - United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio arrives in Colombia on Tuesday, the first stop on a Latin American tour designed to bolster pro-US leaders and cement influence over the continent.

data.title: Malaysian data centres guzzle more power as temperatures soar
data.description: KUALA ​LUMPUR - Malaysia's data centres are consuming more power ​as temperatures rise, leaving ‌a nine-gigawatt gas-fired capacity gap for the government to fill by 2032, officials said on Tuesday.

data.title: France tries 14 over deadliest Channel migrant crossing disaster
data.description: PARIS — Fourteen people are to go on trial in France on Tuesday over the loss of 31 people including a seven-year-old child in 2021, in the deadliest small-boat crossing accident recorded in the Channel.

data.title: What is a Licensed Platform? A Guide to Evaluating Investment Platforms for Beginner Traders
data.description: In an era of rapid Financial Technology (FinTech) development, foreign exchange markets and diverse asset classes haveemergedas some of the most accessible investment channels globally. With daily trading volumes reaching millions of US dollars and the flexibility of 24-hour trading, both beginners and professional investors recognize the opportunities to learn and access highly liquid markets.

data.title: FM Sihasak tells envoy to ensure Israeli visitors respect Thai culture
data.description: Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow has asked Israeli ambassador Alona Fisher-Kamm to be more serious about instructing Israeli tourists to respect Thai culture and traditions, to protect bilateral ties.

data.title: Sweden heads to the polls in close election race
data.description: STOCKHOLM — Sweden votes Sunday in a tight general election that could see the left-wing opposition oust the government after a campaign dominated by concerns over healthcare and the welfare state amid fears over Europe's security.

data.title: No-smoking warning near oil leak on Bangkok’s Rama III Road
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration has warned people not to smoke near drains along a section of Rama III Road because it could ignite an oil leak and cause an explosion.

data.title: Hong Kong customs seizes 200 crickets, 13kg of cockroaches at border checkpoint
data.description: Hong Kong customs officers have intercepted two travellers in separate cases at the Lo Wu border checkpoint for allegedly importing live insects commonly used as reptile feed.
